'''Sean Thielman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Minnesota State Championship]] on 12 May 2001 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|MKOS Skrillings]], according to Tyler Williams's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2297">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-13-mirkwood-minnesota-5-12-01d2297/ mirkwood-minnesota-5-12-01], DeckTech (Tyler "rugman11" Williams, 13 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-13-mirkwood-minnesota-5-12-01d2297/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
